question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

UNFEELING
solution: The correct answer is '**Affectionate**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Unfeeling**' is '**Affectionate**'. • **Unfeeling**: unsympathetic, harsh, or callous. (असंगत, कठोर) • *Example: My mother is a cold, **unfeeling** woman.* • **Affectionate**: readily feeling or showing fondness or tenderness. (स्‍नेही, स्‍नेहशील) • *Example: I love their **affectionate** ways and the eloquent wag of their tails.* **Correct Answer:__*** Affectionate.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Modest**: not talking too much about your own abilities, good qualities, etc. [विनम्र, विनीत (अपनी क्षमताओं आदि का बखान न करने वाला)] • **Cruel**: causing physical or mental pain or suffering to somebody/something. (किसी को शारीरिक अथवा मानसिक पीड़ा देनेवाला; निर्मम, क्रूर) • **Aloof**: not friendly to other people; distant. (मेल-जोल न बढ़ाने वाला; अलग, दूर, भावशून्‍य) 3d:Td06, The correct answer is '**Charitable**'.
